license_note: AWS provides the release as a managed service under the AWS Customer Agreement and the AWS Service Terms Section 60.3 for Amazon Bedrock, which cover the Amazon Nova and Titan foundation models and grant exclusive use of customized Nova models. The terms permit customer applications and Bedrock and SageMaker customization but license no model weights for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to the release through Amazon Bedrock under the AWS Service Terms Section 60.3 and the AWS Customer Agreement

access_boundary: This record represents the Amazon Nova 2 Lite release identified by the Bedrock model ID amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0, launched December 2, 2025. The Nova 1 line, the other Nova 2 sizes, the Sonic, Canvas, and Reel lines, SageMaker and the other Bedrock surfaces, and later Nova releases remain separate service or product boundaries.
strengths: AWS publishes a model card with launch date, lifecycle status, context limits, and the Bedrock model ID
The model card documents the global Bedrock region reach and geo-specific model IDs
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is served only through Amazon Bedrock with no other documented host path

evidence.label: Official Amazon Nova 2 Lite model card
